notes: Idempotent seed for the first governed KPI definitions and source mappings.
Does not write observations, evidence records, or indicator results.
Does not change Power Pages site settings, table permissions, or dashboard data sources.

indicator_definitions.name: Beneficiary profiles imported
indicator_definitions.description: Count of TACATDP beneficiary profiles available in Dataverse after approved baseline import.
indicator_definitions.formula: COUNT(mp_BeneficiaryProfile) filtered by project and active imported baseline records.
indicator_definitions.numerator: Beneficiary profile rows linked to the TACATDP project.
indicator_definitions.verification_method: Reconcile against approved baseline import summary and beneficiary profile read-back counts before treating as official.

mappings.notes: Uses the minimal beneficiary entity created from the baseline import.

indicator_definitions.name: Reported baseline loan amount
indicator_definitions.description: Baseline-reported financing amount captured from the imported TACATDP baseline workbook.
indicator_definitions.formula: SUM(reported loan amount) from imported baseline projection rows where numeric value is available.
indicator_definitions.numerator: Sum of baseline loan amount values.
indicator_definitions.verification_method: Treat as imported baseline value until reconciled with CRDB authoritative finance or core banking records.

mappings.source_column: loan amount / baseline projection numeric field
mappings.transform_rule: Parse numeric loan amount from imported baseline payload and sum valid values.
mappings.notes: Prototype value is not an official disbursement figure.

indicator_definitions.name: Regions represented in baseline
indicator_definitions.description: Number of Tanzania mainland regions represented by imported TACATDP baseline beneficiary records.
indicator_definitions.formula: COUNT_DISTINCT(region) from beneficiary profiles or imported baseline projection rows.
indicator_definitions.numerator: Distinct non-empty region names in imported baseline records.
indicator_definitions.verification_method: Review region vocabulary normalization and exclude non-mainland or unmapped values before official reporting.

mappings.transform_rule: Normalize region labels, exclude empty values, and count distinct mainland regions.
mappings.notes: Supports the regional map and data coverage checks.

indicator_definitions.name: Climate-smart technologies reported
indicator_definitions.description: Count of TACATDP-supported climate-smart technology or practice selections reported in the baseline data.
indicator_definitions.formula: Count selected TACATDP technology/practice categories from imported baseline payload fields.
indicator_definitions.numerator: Selected technology/practice responses mapped to the approved TACATDP intervention catalogue.
indicator_definitions.verification_method: Confirm field-to-intervention mapping and review duplicate/multiple selections before official reporting.

mappings.transform_rule: Map baseline technology/practice fields to approved TACATDP intervention categories and count selections.
mappings.notes: Exact field aliases depend on the latest XLSForm and baseline export headers.

indicator_definitions.name: Training participation reported
indicator_definitions.description: Baseline-reported participation in TACATDP training or capacity-building support.
indicator_definitions.formula: Count beneficiary records with a positive or affirmative training/capacity-building response.
indicator_definitions.numerator: Beneficiaries reporting training or capacity-building support.
indicator_definitions.denominator: Imported baseline beneficiary records with a usable training field response.
indicator_definitions.verification_method: Treat as reported baseline data until verified against attendance records or approved training registers.

mappings.transform_rule: Detect affirmative training/capacity-building responses and count beneficiary participation.
mappings.notes: Women/youth disaggregation requires clean demographic responses in the imported baseline dataset.
